relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine selectively and potently inhibits the voltage gated sodium channel 1.8 (NaV1.8)

relationships.subject: nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: has selective expression on nociceptors within peripheral sensory nerves and dorsal root ganglia, and is not present in the human brain

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Most participants (213 participants; 83.2%) rated suzetrigine's effectiveness for treating pain on a patient global assessment as good, very good, or excellent.

key_findings: In a phase 3 single-arm study (N=256), suzetrigine was generally safe and well tolerated; most adverse events were mild (27.7%) or moderate (8.2%).
83.2% of participants rated suzetrigine effectiveness as good, very good, or excellent across surgical and non-surgical acute pain.
